# Welcome to Nexolith Discussions

Use Discussions for questions, ideas, runtime integration, architecture exploration, benchmarks, and research that are not yet defined enough for an issue.

Please search first, identify the relevant roadmap horizon, separate facts from assumptions, and include reproducible evidence for technical claims. Planned features are not promises. State whether a proposal affects the native cubic runtime, temporary NeoForge bootstrap, Minecraft integration, or an optional compatibility layer. Once a proposal has bounded scope and acceptance criteria, convert it into a linked issue.

Nexolith's built-in systems are not intended to be mandatory feature mods. Proposals must preserve cube authority and keep column-shaped access isolated from native storage, lifecycle, simulation, rendering, networking, and APIs.

AI-assisted contributions are welcome. Discussions about AI tools and AI-assisted work must follow the [AI-Assisted Contribution Policy](../AI_CONTRIBUTION_POLICY.md): focus on technical evidence and project impact, not assumptions about contributors or their chosen tools.

Do not post security vulnerabilities, private information, vanilla or patched Minecraft JARs, generated Minecraft source, Minecraft assets, or sensitive conduct reports publicly.
